score_notes.scripture: The Bible is God's Word to all men. It was written by human authors under the supernatural guidance of the Holy Spirit. It is the ultimate source of truth for Christian beliefs and living.
score_notes.soteriology: Salvation is God's gift to you if you'll accept it. We can never make up for our sin with self-improvement or good works. It is only by trusting in Jesus Christ as God's offer of forgiveness that you can be saved from sin's penalty.
score_notes.preaching: At our services, we present the ageless truths of the Bible in a compelling, easy-to-understand format.
score_notes.mission: The Yulee Baptist Church exists to share God's love in both word and deed so that all people can enter into a saving and growing relationship with our Lord Jesus and His Church.
score_notes.cultural: Our love is for God, and for people of every face, race and background
score_notes.mens_discipleship: Many men lack clarity about what it truly means to be a man. As a result, MANY MEN ARE IN A STATE OF CONFUSION. They end up disappointed with life and find themselves lonely and drifting.
